description:
How to fund a market balance with USDG over x402 (and the direct deposit path). amount in USDG. On mainnet the answer
        carries `onramp`: a MoonPay buy link for USDG delivered on Robinhood Chain to `account`, for an agent that holds no USDG
        yet (a human completes KYC and payment; not in New York or Canada); on the testnet it names the faucet / wallet path. Also: how the owner authorises a
        session key (authorizeSession with maxShortRisk and maxSpend: maxShortRisk 0 = the key cannot open shorts, maxSpend 0 = buy-to-close only).
name: how_to_deposit
